# Ballotpedia

> Ballotpedia is a comprehensive, nonpartisan online encyclopedia of American politics, elections, and government institutions.

Ballotpedia provides detailed information on U.S. elections, federal and state government agencies, judicial proceedings, and political leadership. The site serves as a reference resource for voters, researchers, and citizens seeking factual information about electoral processes and governmental structures.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Congress
- Federal Elections
- 2026 Elections
- Executive Departments
- U.S. Department of Justice
- Cabinet Leadership
- Federal Agencies
- Supreme Court Cases
- State Judicial Districts
- Government Organizations
- Arkansas Politics
- Pam Bondi
- Electoral Information
- Court Decisions
- Political Reference

- [United States Congress elections, 2026](https://ballotpedia.org/United_States_Congress_elections,_2026): Election guide for 2026 U.S. Congress elections covering Senate and House races

- [U.S. Department of Justice](https://ballotpedia.org/U.S._Department_of_Justice): Reference page on U.S. Department of Justice with current leadership including Pam Bondi
